title: Tempest Release
body:
Tempest Release forms from Lightning + Wind. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Gale Spark (help gale spark)
Level 45: Thunderhead Bind (help thunderhead bind)
Level 70: Tempest Lance (help tempest lance)
